text:
tara: heads up — staging hit a weird case: two service accounts share the same display name and quota routing picked the wrong project.
kevin: display-name collision or id duplication?
mike: display-name collision. both SAs show `training-worker` after an import. internal ids differ.
jess: console shows display name at top of selector; ops can choose the wrong one easily.
tara: routing prefers `name` header when available, falls back to `display_name` for some legacy tokens — that fallback caused mis-attribution.
kevin: paste example headers?
mike: incoming request: 
```
Authorization: Bearer tok_oldfmt_01
X-Redwood-Auth: (none)
X-Redwood-SA-Display: training-worker
X-Console-Correlation: cc-77
```
mike: parser failed on `Authorization` because token is pre-migration format.
ops-sheriff: so the in-memory mapping used display name and picked the first match?
jess: yes. our cache key becomes `display_name` when id missing; order after import is nondeterministic.
kevin: using display name as authoritative is unsafe.
mike: short fixes: 1) always prefer canonical id when present, 2) deterministic tie-breaker (org+id sort) for cache, 3) emit `auth.mapping.fallback` telemetry when fallback happens.
tara: telemetry event fields?
kevin: event `auth.mapping.fallback` with fields: token_format, resolved_by (display|id), chosen_key, candidates_count, request_region, console_correlation.
ops-sheriff: add those and a log sampling rule to forward samples to #incidents during canary.
jess: console change: show project+id as primary, display name secondary; flag duplicates with tooltip: "Duplicate display name — confirm".
kevin: rollout: patch runtime to log fallback and deterministic tie-breaker; canary 10% for 48h then 100% if clean.
mike: canary config via env vars: `AUTH_MAPPING_CANARY=0.1` `AUTH_MAPPING_VERBOSE=true`.
tara: ops/sre — dashboard needed: fallback_rate by org, top conflicting display names, affected_projects_count, latency delta when fallback used.
ops-sheriff: will add grafana panel and alert: fallback_rate > 0.5% sustained for 1h => page. also add a sparse log stream to incidents during canary.
kevin: changing routing could shift quotas mid-flight and unexpectedly throttle customers. plan?
jess: add soft-enforcement window: 7 days where new tokens use id-first mapping, existing tokens keep old mapping via `quota_source_version` on token metadata.
mike: token metadata migration required for persisted tokens — doable. also expose per-org UI toggle to opt into early enforcement for partners.
tara: migration UX: don't auto-rename imported SAs. Mark conflicts in console with bulk rename tool and a suggested suffix ` (imported-<shortid>)` if org opts in.
kevin: agree — require admin confirmation before renaming.
ops-sheriff: telemetry: weekly report for PMs with top-10 display-name conflicts by impact (quota hits, error counts).
jess: PR checklist: unit tests for parser fallback, integration test for duplicate imports, console mock for conflict banner, ops runbook.
mike: opening PR with runtime changes and test vectors now.
tara: assigning canary config to @kevin and dashboard/runbook to @ops-sheriff.
ops-sheriff: assigned. will sync with oncall before flipping 10% -> 100%.
infra-bot: deploy queued — build/7891 to staging.
kevin: add metric `route_version` to correlate rollouts and rollbacks.
tara: ack. Tracking this in RFC and looping in product for customer-impact report. :thumbsup:
